svg.title: More balanced gradients, higher policy success
svg.desc: Each action-residual decile's share of summed per-sample parameter-gradient RMS (%). Success-rate bars use a common 0–100% scale with exact values at right. Ten residual-decile midpoints from 5 to 95; all gradient plots share a 0–40% scale. Flow gradient curves use t > 0.5. RoboCasa-GR1 success rates: MSE-Policy 35.55%, Flow-Policy 42.34%, HT-Policy 50.01%; Bridge success rates: MSE-Policy 58.51%, Flow-Policy 62.06%, HT-Policy 62.31%; Fractal success rates: MSE-Policy 60.60%, Flow-Policy 67.83%, HT-Policy 65.25%; Tool-Hang success rates: MSE-Policy 50.00%, Flow-Policy 92.00%, HT-Policy 90.91%
